title: BitFlag protocol v1: shared definitions
description: Definitions referenced by the other v1 schemas through $ref. Length limits count characters here; the specification states the byte limits, which the parsers enforce.

variationKey.description: Key of a variation within one flag.

contextKind.description: Category of an evaluation subject, for example user or organization.

subjectKey.description: Stable identifier of a subject: a string of 1 to 256 UTF-8 bytes. Never a number.

attributeName.description: Name of a context attribute: 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes, case-sensitive.

subjectRef.description: A subject named by kind and key.

rfc3339.description: An RFC 3339 instant with an offset. Uppercase T and Z, seconds 00 to 59, a fraction of 1 to 9 digits. Calendar validity of the day is checked by the parsers.

rfc3339Utc.description: An RFC 3339 instant in UTC (offset Z).

sha256Checksum.description: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

weight.description: Share of the 100,000 buckets: an integer from 0 to 100000.

capability.description: Name of a protocol capability, for example segments.v1.

reason.description: Why an evaluation returned its value.

errorKind.description: Machine-readable cause of a FALLBACK or ERROR result.
